title: Browser-based interactive call/dependency graph explorer for local codebases
user: Engineer onboarding to or refactoring an unfamiliar multi-file codebase
smallest_useful_product: Open a local folder, index TS/JS, Python and Go with tree-sitter-wasm, search symbols, navigate a depth-limited caller/callee/import graph beside clickable source, and export JSON without uploading source.
constraints: Cross-file type resolution is heuristic and must be labelled
monetization: freemium; a one-time Team license unlocks local review-packet export
